shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Runs along the outer right edge; the ball sits here at game start. Whether the plunge is automatic or manual is unconfirmed, and there is no documented lane-specific plunge award.

shots.name: Left Slingshot (Kicking Rubber)
shots.notes: Standard position flanking the left flipper. 30 pts; toggles Multiball Release lamp when a ball is captured.

shots.name: Right Slingshot (Kicking Rubber)
shots.notes: Mirrors the left slingshot. Same scoring/toggle behavior.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Small elements near the top apex of the playfield (position approximate). 30 pts each; toggle Multiball Release lamp when a ball is captured.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: 50,000 pts; awards Extra Ball when lit. Post gap is operator-adjustable, not player-controlled.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Mirrors left outlane; same scoring/EB rule.

shots.name: Left Return Rollover
shots.notes: 3,000 pts; awards EB when lit; flashes Spinner value and arms Display Feature Award sequence if not already running.

shots.name: Right Return Rollover
shots.notes: Mirrors left Return Rollover; same rules.

shots.name: Left Loop/Orbit
shots.notes: Curves from near the left flipper up the left edge into the bumper/target field; backhand-able from a trapped ball. Exact routing is unconfirmed.

shots.name: Spinner
shots.notes: Awards 25,000 when flashing and 5,000 unlit. Position is approximate, placed within the left loop.

shots.name: CLUB Target Bank
shots.notes: 4 standup targets. 10,000 pts flashing/rotating, 1,000 unlit. Completion advances N-I-G-H-T-MOVES ladder, flashes Collect Bonus, self-resets.

shots.name: RIO Target Bank
shots.notes: 3 standup targets. Same scoring/reset behavior as CLUB.

shots.name: R-O-C-K Rollovers
shots.notes: 4 lanes spelling R-O-C-K. 10,000 lit / 5,000 unlit each. Completion lights Extra Ball or scores 100,000 flat if EB already won.

shots.name: Top Right Spot Target
shots.notes: 5,000 pts; awards SPECIAL when lit by completing the full N-I-G-H-T-MOVES ladder, or directly via Display Feature Award.

shots.name: Left Hole (Lock/Switch Saucer)
shots.notes: 10,000 pts flat; runs Lock/Switch mechanic; pays Collect Bonus (50,000 x letters lit, x2 with 2X) when its lamp flashes.

shots.name: Right Hole (Lock/Switch Saucer)
shots.notes: Mirrors Left Hole; identical Lock/Switch/Collect Bonus rules.

shots.name: Upper Right Side Rollover (Multiball Release)
shots.notes: 3,000 pts; releases the captive locked ball for 2-ball multiball when the Release lamp is flashing.

shots.name: Upper Left Side Rollover (Display Feature Award)
shots.notes: Collects the Display Feature Award: flashing value or 50,000, plus one random award from a 7-item pool including Double Entire Score.

shots.name: Top 'Lite 2X' Rollovers
shots.notes: 10,000 lit / 3,000 unlit; lights 2X Bonus when it is unlit; spots a B-A-L-L award letter once 2X is already lit.

shots.name: Right Flipper Button (Rotate/Freeze)
shots.notes: Standalone switch input (not tied to a physical flip): rotates lit Extra Ball / R-O-C-K lamps and freezes the current Top 'Lite 2X' lamp state.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Lower left flipper.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Lower right flipper.

goals.title: Display Feature Award Conversion
goals.summary: Night Moves has no automatic skill shot. The closest thing is this timed inlane-to-rollover conversion — miss the window and the award is gone.

steps.detail: Arms the Display Feature Award sequence (a Return Rollover on either side, or an R-O-C-K lane, does the same thing).

steps.action: Immediately shoot the Upper Left Side Rollover
steps.detail: Collects the flashing award before it times out; reachable from either flipper, so don't force a bad angle.

goals.reward: Flashing value (or 50,000) + one random award: Special, Extra Ball, 500,000, 2X Bonus, 4X Bonus, Win EB, or Double Score

goals.title: CLUB/RIO Bank Farming
goals.summary: Both standup banks self-reset on completion, making them the highest-repeat-value shot pair on the table for stacking the N-I-G-H-T-MOVES ladder.

steps.detail: 4 targets, 10,000 each while flashing/rotating, 1,000 otherwise. Completion advances one ladder letter, flashes a Collect Bonus lamp, and resets the bank.
3 targets, same scoring/reset rules as CLUB. Alternate banks to keep grinding letters back-to-back.

goals.reward: 10,000/target (1,000 unlit) + 1 ladder letter + flashes Collect Bonus; bank self-resets for repeat runs

goals.title: N-I-G-H-T-MOVES Ladder Cash-In
goals.summary: Bank 3+ ladder letters before cashing at a Hole shot — payout is 50,000 per letter lit, doubled if 2X Bonus is lit, up to 600,000 in one shot.

steps.detail: Grind CLUB and RIO banks until 3+ N-I-G-H-T-MOVES letters are lit before cashing in.

steps.action: Shoot the Left Hole while Collect Bonus flashes
steps.detail: Scores 50,000 x letters lit (x2 with 2X Bonus). The Right Hole pays the same when its Collect Bonus lamp flashes.

goals.reward: 50,000 x letters lit (up to 600,000 with 2X Bonus), paid at either Hole when Collect Bonus flashes

goals.title: Return Rollover -> Spinner Rip
goals.summary: The only stated timed shot-value window anywhere in the manual: a Return Rollover flashes the Spinner up to 25,000 for a limited time.

steps.detail: Worth 3,000 flat, and temporarily flashes the Spinner's value up to 25,000 (from a 5,000 base).
Each switch closure scores the flashing 25,000 rate — go before the window drops back to base value.

goals.reward: 3,000 for the rollover + Spinner scores 25,000/switch (vs. 5,000 base) until the flash window drops

goals.title: Lock-and-Switch Shuttle
goals.summary: A genuine point-stealing mechanic: shuttle the locked ball between the two Holes for repeat lock/switch value instead of committing straight to multiball.

steps.action: Lock a ball at the Left Hole
steps.detail: Only while its LOCK lamp is flashing; a fresh ball feeds the shooter lane and the Right Hole's SWITCH lamp starts flashing.

steps.action: Shoot the Right Hole while SWITCH flashes
steps.detail: Captures a ball there, cancels the Left Hole's lock, and kicks the originally-locked ball back into play — relocates the lock rather than starting multiball.

goals.reward: Relocates the lock, returns the original ball to play, and lets you repeat the lock/switch shuttle before starting multiball

goals.title: Full Ladder -> Top Right Special
goals.summary: The natural endpoint of bank-farming: complete all six N-I-G-H-T-MOVES letters to light the game's only Special award.

steps.detail: Keep completing and resetting the bank to add ladder letters.
Alternate with CLUB until all 6 N-I-G-H-T-MOVES letters are lit.

steps.action: Shoot the Top Right Spot Target
steps.detail: Awards SPECIAL once the full ladder is complete (5,000 pts on any other hit).

goals.reward: SPECIAL award once all 6 N-I-G-H-T-MOVES letters are lit; 5,000 pts on any other hit to the target

goals.title: Two-Ball Multiball — Left Hole Lock
goals.summary: The core multiball chain: lock a ball, toggle the release lamp with bumpers/slingshots, then release for true simultaneous 2-ball multiball. Two balls is the ceiling.

steps.detail: Shoot while its LOCK lamp is flashing; captures the ball and serves a fresh one to the shooter lane so play continues.
Each hit toggles the Multiball Release lamp on/off while a ball is captured — time your next shot for when it's lit.

steps.action: Shoot the Upper Right Side Rollover while Release flashes
steps.detail: Kicks the locked ball out to join the live ball for real 2-ball multiball.

goals.reward: True 2-ball multiball — no jackpot exists; benefit is doubled shot rate for normal points until balls drain back to one

goals.title: Two-Ball Multiball — Right Hole Lock
goals.summary: Mirror path to the same multiball — either Hole can carry the initial lock depending on which LOCK lamp happens to be flashing.

steps.detail: Shoot while its LOCK lamp is flashing.
Toggles Multiball Release the same as the left side — any bumper or sling hit counts.

steps.action: Release via the Upper Right Side Rollover
steps.detail: Same release shot regardless of which Hole is holding the lock.

goals.reward: Same true 2-ball multiball as the left-lock path — doubled shot rate for normal points, no jackpot exists

goals.title: Switch-Shuttle Multiball Setup
goals.summary: If the flashing LOCK hole is the tougher shot, use the SWITCH mechanic to relocate the lock to the easier Hole before releasing.

steps.action: Lock at whichever Hole is easier to hit first
steps.detail: Starts the chain even if it isn't your preferred long-term shot.

steps.action: Shoot the opposite Hole while SWITCH flashes
steps.detail: Moves the captured ball to that Hole and kicks the original ball out — relocates the lock to your preferred side.

steps.action: Release once Multiball Release is lit
steps.detail: Requires bumper/slingshot toggles first, identical to the direct-lock path.

goals.reward: Same 2-ball multiball, reached via your preferred Hole — doubled shot rate for normal points, no jackpot exists

goals.title: Display Feature Award
goals.summary: Night Moves' only sequential award system — a rotating pool of random prizes including the game's single biggest payout, Double Entire Score.

steps.detail: Any Return Rollover, or an R-O-C-K lane, starts or re-arms Display Feature Award if it isn't already cycling.

steps.action: Collect at the Upper Left Side Rollover
steps.detail: Scores the flashing value (or 50,000) and awards one of: light Special, light Extra Ball, score 500,000, light 2X Bonus, Collect 4X Bonus, Win Extra Ball, or Double Entire Score.

goals.reward: Flashing value (or 50,000) + one of: Special, Extra Ball, 500,000, 2X Bonus, 4X Bonus, Win EB, or Double Entire Score

goals.title: R-O-C-K Rollover Sequence
goals.summary: Spell R-O-C-K across four lanes for a lit Extra Ball, or a flat 100,000 once Extra Ball is already lit/won.

steps.action: Collect R, O, C, and K
steps.detail: 10,000 pts each while lit, 5,000 unlit. Completion lights Extra Ball or scores 100,000 flat if EB is already won.
Press the right flipper button to rotate which Extra Ball / R-O-C-K lamps are lit before committing to a shot.

goals.reward: 10,000/lane (5,000 unlit); completing R-O-C-K lights Extra Ball, or scores 100,000 flat if EB is already won

goals.title: N-I-G-H-T-MOVES Bonus Ladder
goals.summary: The six-letter bonus ladder underlying most of the game's scoring — advanced by the CLUB and RIO banks, cashed in at the Holes.

steps.detail: Completing the bank adds one ladder letter and flashes a Collect Bonus lamp.
Same effect as CLUB; alternate banks since both self-reset for repeat value.
Scores 50,000 per letter lit when that Hole's Collect Bonus lamp is flashing.

goals.reward: +1 ladder letter per bank + flashes Collect Bonus; cash in at a Hole for 50,000 per letter lit

goals.title: 2X Bonus — Lite via Top Rollovers
goals.summary: The game's only persistent multiplier: a binary bonus-doubler lit at the top rollovers and lockable with the right flipper button.

steps.detail: 10,000 pts lit / 3,000 unlit; lights 2X Bonus when it is unlit; spots a B-A-L-L award letter once 2X is already lit.

steps.action: Freeze it right before cashing bonus
steps.detail: Press just before a Hole-shot Collect Bonus cash-in — freezing early protects nothing you haven't already earned.

goals.reward: 10,000 (3,000 unlit) + lights 2X Bonus; once already lit, instead spots a B-A-L-L award letter

goals.title: 4X Bonus via Display Feature Award
goals.summary: A one-shot x4 bonus payout rolled from the Display Feature Award pool — a single immediate multiply, not a persistent multiplier level.

steps.detail: Via a Return Rollover or the R-O-C-K lane.

steps.action: Collect when 'Collect 4X Bonus' is the flashing award
steps.detail: Applies an immediate one-time x4 to your current bonus total — it does not persist like the 2X lamp.
Take a Hole cash-in or let the ball drain promptly so the 4X payout isn't put at risk by a later tilt.

goals.reward: Immediate one-time x4 on current bonus total (not persistent like 2X Bonus) — bank it via a Hole shot right after

goals.title: Double Entire Score — the Closest Thing to a Wizard Mode
goals.summary: Night Moves has no wizard mode of any kind. This is the real qualification path to its single largest possible payout, chaining the bonus ladder, the 2X multiplier, and the rarest Display Feature Award outcome.

steps.detail: Sets up doubled Hole-shot cash-ins for the rest of the ball.
Push the N-I-G-H-T-MOVES ladder toward 5-6 letters for maximum cash-in value as a guaranteed fallback.
Any Return Rollover or R-O-C-K shot re-arms it whenever it isn't already cycling.

steps.action: Convert at the Upper Left Side Rollover repeatedly
steps.detail: Each cycle rolls a new random award; Double Entire Score is one of seven possible outcomes — there is no way to force it.

steps.action: Bank the guaranteed ladder value along the way
steps.detail: Cash Collect Bonus at a Hole whenever it's flashing so the chase for Double Score isn't your only source of points.

goals.reward: Double Entire Score — the biggest possible payout, 1 of 7 random Display Feature Award outcomes; can't be forced

goals.title: Opening 30 Seconds
goals.summary: No skill shot exists, so the opener is about sequencing straight into the CLUB/RIO banks, not a special first shot.

steps.detail: No documented lane-specific plunge award exists on this table — no reason to soft-plunge.

steps.action: Work whichever bank has fewer targets left, CLUB or RIO
steps.detail: Highest early-value priority: advances the ladder and lights Collect Bonus, then resets for more.

steps.action: Take a Hole shot once it's open
steps.detail: Starts Lock progress and, if Collect Bonus is lit, cashes an early 50-100K even with just 1-2 letters lit.

goals.reward: Ladder progress + Lock started + an early 50,000-100,000 Collect Bonus cash-in with just 1-2 letters lit

goals.title: Bonus-Before-Bailout Discipline
goals.summary: Tilting wipes all accumulated bonus and bonus multipliers outright — the single most expensive mistake once you're carrying letters.

steps.action: Cash the ladder at 3+ letters rather than hoarding
steps.detail: 150,000+ base, 300,000+ doubled — no opportunity cost since the Hole shot also builds Lock.
Freezing earlier protects nothing extra — it only locks in a state you've already earned.

steps.action: Avoid aggressive nudging once 3+ letters are lit
steps.detail: A tilt at that point zeroes the entire bonus ladder and any 2X built up, per the manual's tilt rule.

goals.reward: 150,000+ banked (300,000+ doubled) instead of losing it all to a tilt, which zeroes the entire bonus ladder and 2X

goals.title: Extra Ball Path Priority
goals.summary: Four independent ways to light Extra Ball, but only one is awarded per ball-in-play — know which to prioritize.

steps.detail: Lights Extra Ball, or scores a flat 100,000 if EB is already lit/won.
3,000 pts and awards EB when lit.

steps.action: Chase Display Feature Award's EB outcomes
steps.detail: Two of its seven possible awards are Extra-Ball-related — highest variance path.
50,000 pts and EB when lit — not a pure drain here, but lit state and post gap are operator-set, not player-controlled.

goals.reward: Extra Ball — only one per ball-in-play, via whichever path lights first (R-O-C-K, Return Rollover, Display Award, or Outlane)

goals.title: B-A-L-L Letter Spotting
goals.summary: Once 2X Bonus is already lit, the top rollovers stop being a multiplier shot and start spotting B-A-L-L award letters instead — so the lane keeps earning after the doubler is locked.
goals.reward: 10,000 per lit roll (3,000 unlit) plus one B-A-L-L award letter spotted per pass while 2X Bonus is lit

steps.detail: The lane only spots a B-A-L-L letter once the 2X lamp is already lit; while it is unlit, the roll lights 2X instead.

steps.action: Freeze the top lamp state you want
steps.detail: The button freezes the current top lane lamp state, so you can hold the arrangement that keeps spotting letters.
Each pass through spots another letter while 2X stays lit; feed the lanes off the pop bumper area rather than aiming for one specific lane.

goals.title: Cash The Ladder During Multiball
goals.summary: Two-ball play has no jackpot, so the best use of the extra ball is doubling your rate at the banks and then feeding a Hole while Collect Bonus is still flashing — the payout lands before the second ball drains.
goals.reward: 50,000 per lit ladder letter (doubled with 2X Bonus) banked while two balls are still in play

steps.detail: Release the locked ball while the Release lamp is flashing; you now have two balls and a short window of doubled shot rate.

steps.action: Sweep a bank with two balls live
steps.detail: Completing CLUB or RIO adds a ladder letter and flashes a Collect Bonus lamp — far easier with a second ball rattling the targets.

steps.action: Feed a Hole while Collect Bonus flashes
steps.detail: Pays 50,000 per lit letter (doubled with 2X). Either Hole works, so take whichever one the live ball actually gives you a clean angle at.

achievements.title: Clean Sweep
achievements.desc: Knock down every target in the CLUB bank (or the RIO bank) in a single ball to advance the bonus ladder once.

achievements.title: First Payday
achievements.desc: Collect a Hole shot while its Collect Bonus lamp is flashing to bank your first ladder-letter bonus payout.

achievements.title: Doubler Up
achievements.desc: Light 2X Bonus by rolling the top rollover lanes while the 2X lamp is unlit.

achievements.title: Spinner At Full Rate
achievements.desc: Rip the Spinner while its value is flashing at the boosted rate, immediately after a Return Rollover.

achievements.title: Take What The Display Offers
achievements.desc: Arm the Display Feature Award and collect it at the Upper Left Side Rollover before the flashing award times out.

achievements.title: Four Lanes, One Word
achievements.desc: Collect all four R-O-C-K rollover lanes to complete the sequence.

achievements.title: One More Ball
achievements.desc: Earn and collect an Extra Ball through any of the game's lit paths.

achievements.title: Ball In The Bank
achievements.desc: Capture a ball at either Hole while its LOCK lamp is flashing.

achievements.title: Two At Once
achievements.desc: Release the locked ball at the Upper Right Side Rollover while the Release lamp is flashing to run true two-ball play.

achievements.title: Move The Lock
achievements.desc: Complete a full lock-and-switch: capture at one Hole, then shoot the opposite Hole while SWITCH flashes to relocate the lock and kick the original ball back into play.

achievements.title: Spot The Whole Word
achievements.desc: With 2X Bonus already lit, keep rolling the top rollovers until every B-A-L-L award letter has been spotted.

achievements.title: Maximum Cash-In

achievements.desc: Roll the 4X Bonus outcome from the Display Feature Award pool and bank the resulting bonus total.

drills.title: Alternate the Banks
drills.text: CLUB and RIO both reset themselves the moment you clear them, which makes them the highest-repeat-value pair on the table. Clear one, immediately swing to the other, and keep alternating without stopping to chase anything else.

drills.title: Use the Rollover Window
drills.text: A Return Rollover does two jobs at once: it flashes the Spinner up to its high value and it arms the Display Feature Award. Roll one, then commit immediately — rip the Spinner while the value is up, or go straight to the Upper Left rollover to convert the award. The failure being drilled out is letting both windows expire while you think it over.
drills.reps: 10 rollovers, alternating which follow-up you take

drills.title: Wait Out the Release Lamp
drills.text: With a ball captured, every bumper and slingshot hit flips the Multiball Release lamp on or off. Cradle and watch the lamp rather than shooting on instinct — the Upper Right rollover only releases while it is flashing, so the skill is holding the ball until the toggle lands your way.

drills.title: The Button's Second Job
drills.text: Outside of flipping, the right button rotates which Extra Ball and R-O-C-K lamps are lit and freezes the 2X state. Cradle on the left flipper and work the button alone until you can set the lamps where you want them before committing to a shot. Save the freeze for the moment just before a Hole cash-in, since freezing early protects nothing you have not already earned.
drills.reps: one full ball spent setting lamps first

drills.title: Cash Whichever Hole Flashes
drills.text: Three lit letters is already worth banking, and both Holes pay identically when their Collect Bonus lamp is flashing. Drill taking the one the ball actually gives you a clean angle at instead of waiting for your favorite side, since either shot also builds Lock progress.

actionButton.how: Night Moves is a cocktail table — no backbox, one shared pair of flippers, and buttons on opposite cabinet edges so players can sit across from each other. There is no separate action button. What it does have is a second job stacked onto the right flipper button: outside of flipping, it rotates which Extra Ball and R-O-C-K lamps are lit and freezes the 2X Bonus state, so you can set the lamps up before you commit to a shot.

howItPlays.objective: Night Moves is a two-sided cocktail table sharing one pair of flippers. Grind the CLUB and RIO target banks to climb the bonus ladder, cash it doubled at the holes, and chase Double Entire Score.
loop: Sweep the CLUB and RIO standup banks; each completion adds a letter to the bonus ladder and flashes a hole to cash it, then the bank resets itself for another run.
Cash the ladder at whichever hole is flashing Collect Bonus for points per letter, and light 2X at the top rollovers first to double the payout.
Lock a ball in a hole, flip the Release lamp with bumpers and slingshots, then let it out at the upper-right rollover for real two-ball play.
Roll a return rollover to flash the spinner hot and to arm the Display Feature Award, then convert that award at the upper-left rollover.
Keep the Display Feature Award cycling for a run at Double Entire Score, the largest payout this table has to give.

lights.name: N-I-G-H-T-MOVES Ladder
lights.lit: Each CLUB or RIO bank you finish lights one more ladder letter and then resets so you can stack letters back to back, and a lit letter stays lit right up until you drain.
lights.flashing: A Collect Bonus lamp flashing at a hole means that hole is set to pay your banked letters this instant.
lights.then: Build a few letters, then cash them at whichever hole flashes Collect Bonus for points per lit letter. Light the whole word to arm the Top Right Spot Target for the only Special the game offers.

lights.name: Hole Locks & Release
lights.lit: A flashing LOCK lamp at a hole means it will trap your ball and serve a fresh one, and once a ball is held the Multiball Release lamp toggles on and off with every bumper or slingshot hit.
lights.flashing: The Release lamp flashing at the upper-right rollover is your signal that the held ball can be let loose.
lights.then: Lock a ball, wait out the bumper toggle until Release flashes, then shoot the upper-right rollover for real two-ball play. Want the other hole instead? Shoot it while its SWITCH lamp flashes to move the lock over first.

lights.name: R-O-C-K Rollovers
lights.lit: The four R-O-C-K lanes each carry a letter lamp, a lit one is a letter you still need, and rolling it banks that letter.

control.effect: a press of the right flipper button rotates which R-O-C-K lane lamps are lit, so you can line the letter you still need up under the ball instead of collecting one twice
control.when: before the ball rolls the lanes

lights.then: Rotate the lamps, roll the lanes, and finish R-O-C-K to light an extra ball -- or a flat points award once that extra ball is already yours.

lights.name: Lite 2X Top Rollovers
lights.lit: The top rollovers light 2X Bonus while it is dark, and once 2X is up they switch jobs, handing out a B-A-L-L award letter on each later pass.

control.effect: a press of the right flipper button locks the top rollovers' lamp arrangement in place, so you can hold the layout you want just ahead of a cash-in

lights.then: Roll the tops to light 2X so every hole cash-in pays double, then freeze it and keep re-rolling to spot B-A-L-L letters for more awards. Freeze only as you are about to cash, since doing it early protects nothing extra.

lights.name: Display Feature Award
lights.lit: Rolling either return rollover arms the Display Feature Award, and the upper-left rollover then lights to collect whatever prize is flashing before it times out.
lights.flashing: The upper-left rollover flashing means an award is live and waiting -- grab it or lose it.
lights.then: Arm it on a return, then take the upper-left rollover for the flashing value plus one random prize -- a Special, an extra ball, a big points bump, a bonus multiplier, or the rare Double Entire Score. Re-arm it every ball for repeated rolls at the big one.

lights.name: Spinner
lights.lit: A return rollover kicks the spinner's worth up to its top rate for a short spell, and while that boost holds every blade of the spin scores at the raised number rather than the base.
lights.flashing: The spinner's value lamp burning bright is the window -- rip it now.
lights.then: Roll a return, then rip the spinner right away before the boost drops back down. It is the one clean timed-value window anywhere on the table.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: The right flipper button carries a second job past flipping: press it to rotate which R-O-C-K lane lamp is lit, lining the letter you still need up before the ball rolls an inlane or outlane so you never waste one on a letter already yours. Finishing R-O-C-K lights an extra ball. That same button also freezes the top-lane 2X state for a doubled cash-in.

scoring.text: There is no skill shot here, so plunge full and go straight to the CLUB and RIO banks -- they reset on every clear and are the highest repeat value on the table. Cash an early hole for a quick payout even on a letter or two.

Climb toward a full word, light 2X at the tops so each hole cash-in pays double, and run the lock-toggle-release chain for two-ball play. Sweep a bank with two balls loose, feed a hole while Collect Bonus still flashes, and rip the spinner off a return whenever it flashes hot.

The ceiling is Double Entire Score, one of seven random Display Feature Award results -- keep re-arming the award and converting at the upper-left rollover, since nothing lets you force it. Lighting the full ladder to claim the Top Right Special is the other endgame prize.
